target: Styles are missing only in the sterile ray florets (ray flower PO_0009331? no: ray flower PO_0025331). The disc florets have styles (style PO_0009074). The pappus statement is about another part and does not touch the style.
fix: '<sterile/ray/outer> florets ... without styles' gives style absent (PO_0009074, PATO_0000462) only inside the ray flower (PO_0025331) context. It never gives a style absence for the whole taxon.

target: Only female florets are missing: the head has bisexual florets only, flower PO_0009046 with female PATO_0000383 absent. Do not annotate flower absent.

target: Petal (PO_0009032) absent only in the lower flowers, rarely in all of them. The other flowers have petals with a ciliate claw.

target: Awnless: the uppermost rudimentary (sterile) floret, a clavate scale. Awned (2-awned): the fertile lemma and the first sterile floret (lemma, awn PO_0025349).

target: No annotation. This is missing data (flowers not observed), not flower PO_0009046 absent.
fix: '<part> not known / not seen / unknown / not available / not described' is missing data. Drop it (or record it as not observed). It is never PATO_0000462 absent.
reason: The taxon is known from material without flowers. An inflorescence was described, so the flowers exist.

target: staminode PO_0009077 absent (PATO_0000462). The stamens are present, and 'flattened' stays on the stamen or filament.
fix: 'staminodes absent' is an absence of staminode PO_0009077, not stamen PO_0009029. Lexical matching must not reduce staminode/staminodia to stamen.
reason: Many Chrysophyllum lack staminodes but have fertile stamens.

target: Leafless only at times (the leaves fall early, so the stems are often bare): whole plant leafless phenotype FLOPO_0985035 qualified by 'frequently'. Leaves fleshy when present.
fix: 'frequently/often/usually/sometimes leafless' and 'leafless when flowering' are partial or stage-bound absences. Attach the frequency or stage context. Never read them as a plain leaf absent.
reason: C. quadrangularis has early-deciduous leaves on its succulent stems. Leaves exist and are described.

target: Gland at the petal base absent: flower nectary PO_0009056 (petal-base gland) absent, PATO_0000462. Petals present.

target: Absence of the fruit's apical peg (the receptacle remnant at the fruit apex). PO has no class for it, so leave it unannotated. The fruit is present.
fix: '<feature> absent' after a fruit or organ subject is an absence of that feature, here 'apical peg', 'beak' or 'stipe'. If the feature has no term, drop it. Never move the absence onto the organ.
reason: A Combretum fruit 'apical peg' is a small apical structure. The fruit is described (apex retuse).

target: Leafless only on the long whiplike shoot ends (shoot axis PO_0025029). The rest of the branches are leafy.

target: Ovary (PO_0009072) completely absent in the male flowers (no pistillode, PO_0009078). Female flowers have a glabrous ovary.
fix: In dioecious or unisexual-flower descriptions, a part absence inside the ♂ or ♀ flower paragraph ('ovary completely absent', 'pistillode absent') belongs to that sex's flowers (male PATO_0000384 / female PATO_0000383 context).

target: No spines on the branches (thorn PO_0025172 absent in the branch context). Spines reported on the main stem by one collector.

target: Corolla (PO_0009059) absent in the marginal female florets. Disc florets have a tubular corolla.
fix: In Asteraceae, 'without a corolla' after 'female/marginal/outer florets' is a corolla absence only in that floret kind.
reason: Cotula's outer female florets lack a corolla. The disc florets have a 4-lobed tubular corolla.

target: No annotation for 'not seen' (missing data). The flora also has a real conflict here: it describes woolly fruit while saying fruits were not seen, so check whether the woolly part is the ovary or young fruit.

target: Only the secondary bracts are absent. The primary bracts (bract PO_0009055) are present and deciduous.

target: aerial tuber PO_0004548 absent (PATO_0000462). The underground tuber (PO_0025522) is present, replaced annually.

target: aril PO_0009090 absent. The seed is present. Also 'hilum minute' should go to hilum PO_0020063 with decreased size, not to the seed.
fix: In a seed paragraph, '<subpart> absent' (aril, strophiole, caruncle) is an absence of that subpart. The paragraph subject does not inherit the absence.

target: bract PO_0009055 deciduous only. 'Not seen' is missing data (they fall early).

target: A negated quality of stipule PO_0020041: not aculeate (no prickly or spine tip). Drop it, or record that the stipule is unarmed. The stipule is present (orange-brown).

target: No annotation: 'style not seen' is missing data. The pappus statement is unrelated.

target: Stamens (PO_0009029) absent in the female flowers. Male flowers have sessile stamens.

target: Pappus (PO_0025393) absent from most florets. Where present it is very scant (PATO_0001609).
fix: 'absent from most/some <members>' is a partial absence. Keep it with its quantifier, or drop it. It should not be a plain absence.

target: No annotation for 'not seen'. Also drop the speculative 'probably the roots' pubescence on root PO_0009005.

target: Erect stems ± absent (leaves arise from the rhizome PO_0004542 nodes). Drop the 'stem: erect' record, because it is the subject of the absence clause.

target: The plant has no leafy stems (acaulescent: aerial stem PO_0009047 absent or leafless). Leaves present and basal. Not leaf absent.
